page.content:
City, Republic, and Empire that organized the Mediterranean for a millennium.

How Ancient Rome connects

  • Location: Rome — The city of Rome is the namesake and first capital of the Roman world.
  • Faction: Roman Republic — The Republic is Rome's classical political form.
  • Faction: Roman Empire — The Empire is Rome after Augustus monopolized power.

What is Ancient Rome?

Ancient Rome is the public-domain history of the city on the Tiber: kings, the Republic, the principate, and late imperial transformation. Its lore runs through Senate and Forum, legion and law, Carthage, Caesar, and Constantine.

Key threads lead to Rome, Roman Republic and Roman Empire.
